correctness.rationale: TARGET route: draft proves the admitted triple in the CAS leg the topic explicitly allows. Hand-verified: Delta=37 from a-invariants; #E(F5)=8 so a5=-2 ordinary; Kronecker(-11/5)=Kronecker(-11/37)=1 so split hypotheses hold; group law gives -3*(0,0)=(-1,0) confirming the index-3 relation and height ratio 9. Reported 5-adic values are internally consistent: Rgen/R00=4+5+O(5^10) encodes 9, R(8P)/R(P)=4+2*5+2*5^2 encodes 64, Lp'/R00 is a unit, Euler factor (1-alpha^-1)^-2 is a unit since alpha=3 mod 5. Valuation 1 against O(5^11) with stability across n=6,8,10 plus quadraticity controls makes nonvanishing rigorous conditional on PARI's tracked precision, a limitation the draft honestly discloses. Base-change transfer from E(Q) to E(K) via equal ranks plus trivial torsion is standard and sound.

originality.rationale: Fused search (20 results, all providers ok) finds only general theorems and different-curve computations. Body-level inspection of the nearest computational prior (Balakrishnan-Ciperiani-Stein) shows its worked examples are 57a1/331a1/203b1/185b1 only, with no 37a1 or Q(sqrt(-11))/p=5 triple. Disegni's theorem proves the general h-vs-derivative equivalence but states no numerical value for this triple (full-text search for 37a1 returns nothing), so it implies the equivalence shape, not the nonvanishing fact. No table or database records this regulator: LMFDB covers only classical invariants of 37a1. The exact 5-adic regulator value and its valuation are new and not mechanically implied.

value.rationale: Exact nonvanishing invariant of a natural, pre-motivated object: the canonical rank-one Gross-Zagier curve 37a1 at the minimal ordinary split prime p=5 over the Heegner field Q(sqrt(-11)). The cyclotomic regulator valuation 1 and the ord=1 p-adic BSD consequence were not known and are not mechanically implied, since cyclotomic heights can vanish on nontorsion points and only computation decides it. Per the shared standard, a rigorously established exact invariant of a specific natural object needs no new general theorem. This is not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration.
